notes.title: ULTRAWORLD EXODUS is out!
notes.notes:
The free add-on is now available for all ULTRAWORLD owners. So what's new?

[b]Story Redux:[/b] The original story has been nipped and tucked in many ways. Still as divisive as ever!

[b]Final Chapter:[/b] A continuation of the previous story and a conclusion. This new story features all new areas that equal the original game in size.

[b]Vacation Mode Expanded:[/b] Now you have infinite color at your fingertips; change up the look and take pictures as you fly about the landscape! Watch the developer explain in this video:
 [url=https://youtu.be/L9JFQiUIQbI] Let's Play Vacation Mode [/url] 

[b]VR Support:[/b] Welcome to a new reality. Not recommended for those with weak stomachs. Takes some work to setup (details incoming).

[b]Free:[/b] This new content is no additional cost. It's just considered to be part of the original game now. It's my way of saying thanks to those who supported me early on!
